speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing fatigue, malaise, and unintentional weight loss; these are significant symptoms that require a careful history. To begin our assessment, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have you noticed any fevers, night sweats, or changes in your appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: 71-year-old male. The patient complains of fatigue and malaise over the last few months. He also reports an unintentional weight loss of 18.1 kg over the past 6 months. He does not recall any changes in diet or exercise routines that could explain the weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. The significant weight loss of 18.1 kg over six months is concerning; given your age, have you noticed any new lumps, swollen glands, or persistent cough during this time? Also, have you experienced any changes in bowel habits or difficulty swallowing?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue and malaise. I also have Significant unintentional weight loss, No change in diet or exercise.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma (B-symptoms: weight loss, malaise; age >60).
